FQHESphereASCIIToState, version 0.01

    --su4-spin : consider particles with SU(4) spin
    -i, --total-isosz : twice the z component of the total isospin of the system (only usefull in su(4) mode) (default value = 0)
    --2-ll : consider particles within two Landau levels
    --ascii-state : name of the input ASCII description of the state (should use the same convention than FQHESphereShowBasis output)
